40:41: Yaa ummata kiyya! Maali! kan Ani gara nageenyaatti isin waamu, isin immoo gara ibiddaatti na waamtanii?
40:42: Na waamtu Akka ani Rabbitti kafaruufi waan waa’ee isaa beekumsa hin qabne isatti qindeessuuf. Ani immoo gara (Rabbii) injifataa, araaramaa ta’eettin isin waama.
40:43: Dhugumatti, wanti isin itti na waamtan sun addunyaa keessattis ta’ee Aakhiraa keessatti kadhaan isaaf hinjiru. deebiin keenya gara Rabbiiti. daangaa dabroonni isaan warroota ibiddaati.
40:44: Waanin ani isiniin jedhu kana yaadachuuf jirtu. Ani dhimma kiyya gara Rabbiittin hirkifadha. Rabbiin gabroota Isaa argaadha.”
40:45: Rabbiin hamtuuwwan waan isaan itti wal mari’atanii jalaa isa baraarse. Maatii Fir’awnitti adabbii hamaatu bu'e.
40:46: Ibidda (jahannam) kan qabrii keessattinganamaafi galgala ishee irra fidamantu (isaanitti bu'e). Guyyaa Qiyaamaan dhaabattu “maatii Fir’awni azaaba akkaan cimaa seensisaa.” (jedhama).
40:47: Yeroo ibidda keessatti wal mormanii, isaan dadhaboon isaan boonaniin jedhan “nuti isiniif hordofoo tahuu turre, sila isin nurraa deebisoodhaa qooda ibidarraa tahe?” (jedhan san) (yaadadhu.)
40:48: Isaan boonan nijedhan “nuti hunduu isheedhuma keessa jirra; Rabbiin dhugumatti gidduu gabrootaatti murteesseera”.
40:49: Isaan ibidda keessa jiran waardiyyoota jahannamiin nijedhan “Gooftaa keessan nuuf kadhaa (hanguma) guyyaa tokko (kan addunyaa) adabbii akka nurraa salphisu”.
